results.description:
Stitchly is the best cross stitch pattern maker app on iPhone and iPad. Easily create your own cross stitch patterns with this simple yet powerful app.

• Perfect for beginners and professionals
• Convert your photos or draw your own designs
• Use DMC and Anchor thread, plus lots more
• Use 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, backstitches, and French knots
• Export your work as a printable PDF
• Track your progress in the app
• No subscriptions (pay once, enjoy forever)


IT WORKS LIKE MAGIC

When converting a photo, use our custom-built wizard tool to effortlessly choose the best settings for your image and see the results instantly.


TRACE OVER IMAGES

When drawing your own designs, you can show an image in the background. This can be super helpful as a reference to trace over. You can also show the original image after converting a photo, which makes tidying up your patterns even easier.


MAKE YOUR MASTERPIECE

Once your pattern is finished and you’re ready to get stitching, simply press play. You can view your pattern in the app, highlight symbols, and mark stitches as completed using the progress tracker.


JOIN THOUSANDS OF HAPPY CUSTOMERS...

"I can’t overstate my love for Stitchly. Every time I don’t see it on a top 10 softwares for cross stitch I’m shook. I‘ve been making and selling patterns for 5 years and have tried 3 other programs but Stitchly’s aesthetics, simplicity, and constant feature updates make it my number one favorite of all time." - By Nic806 on the App Store

"This app is exactly what I’ve been looking for! I had been eyeing a few desktop apps but this app provides all the features I need in a cheaper, convenient, portable app- even better! I love how easy it is to make patterns and export them, even including the number of skeins needed in the export is so helpful." - By reydiant on the App Store

"The best app for anyone that likes cross stitch. I’ve saved so much money on buying patterns and it’s also so much fun to be able to design my own. Love it. I never spend money on apps but this one was definitely worth it." - By TJ_172940 on the App Store


BECOME AN AMAZING DESIGNER

Our mission is to make it easier and more fun to create your own cross stitch designs. Why? Because being creative makes you happier and healthier.


AS FEATURED BY APPLE

Stitchly has been featured as App of the Day on the App Store. We are incredibly proud of this milestone and wish to thank all our wonderful customers for their continued support.


FAQ

Is the full version a one-time purchase?
Yes. There are no subscriptions. You can create and export as many patterns as you like with the one-time purchase.

Can I unlock my other devices using the same purchase?
Yes. You can unlock the full version on your iPhone, iPad and Mac (M1 chip or later) with just one purchase.

Can I share the purchase with my family?
Yes. Family Sharing is enabled.

Can I sell my patterns?
Yes. You can also add your store details to your PDF exports.

Do I have to buy the materials separately?
Yes. The app is only for creating patterns.

Can I use Stitchly for needlepoint?
Yes. Many of our customers use the Stitchly app to create both cross stitch and needlepoint patterns. When using the app for needlepoint, just treat each square as one canvas intersection.

Is Stitchly an alternative to Stitch Fiddle?
Yes. Stitchly is an app, whereas Stitch Fiddle is an online platform. Stitchly is not affiliated with Stitch Fiddle.

Where is my data stored?
Your data is stored on your device. All processing is done locally on your device. Your data is never transmitted to third parties.


TRY IT NOW

Try Stitchly now on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. The full version is a one-time purchase.

Find out more at stitchly.com

results.description:
• Powerful markup made simple
Spend less time managing your chart and more time stitching, with a clear interactive view that makes every symbol and remaining stitch easy to find.

• Free two-week trial
Try every feature free for two weeks and experience how Markup R-XP can make your stitching simpler and more enjoyable.

• Easy chart importing and setup
Start stitching sooner, even when your chart is a PDF, scan, image or photo, with tools that straighten the chart and help detect its grid and symbols - even one that’s angled or curled in a book!

• Automatic thread setup
Save setup time and avoid colour-matching mistakes by identifying threads from the chart key, creating blended symbols and choosing from a wide range of built-in manufacturer shade cards.

Enjoy multi-page charts as one seamless, correctly counted design without troublesome page boundaries and expand Stitch-Along (SAL) projects as new sections are released.

Always know where you are and what remains, with keys, reference pictures, finished samples, notes and detailed progress information kept together and easy to find.

• Customisable to suit you
Create a clearer, more comfortable stitching experience by personalising the app theme, grids, guides, colours, sizes and other display options.

• Help, community and regular improvements
Find answers when you need them, connect with a friendly community of stitchers and enjoy ongoing improvements inspired by user feedback.

Turn any photo into a printable cross-stitch chart in seconds — right on your phone.

StitchSnap matches your photo to industry-standard DMC floss codes, generates a multi-page printable PDF, and gives you a written stitch-by-stitch pattern — everything you need to start stitching today.

Built phone-camera-first. No desktop software and no clunky browser tools — snap a photo of your pet, your kid, or a favorite memory and get a stitchable chart on the spot. The color matching is tuned for the subjects other converters get wrong: it stays accurate on fur and on skin tones, mapping to the real DMC flosses stitchers actually use.

Pick a sample, snap a photo with the camera, or upload from your library. Choose Quick for a fast preview, Standard for the sweet spot, or Detailed for a high-resolution chart. Get a finished-piece preview before you commit to your floss.

Free: chart preview with watermark. Unlock the full printable PDF + complete DMC color list for one pattern with a one-time $1.99 purchase — no subscription required. Want unlimited charts? Subscribe: Annual ($29.99/year) or Weekly ($5.99/week).
